name: webhub
description: Hub for mods with a browser page: one local server that hosts every mod's own page, lists them by session and passes what you press there back to the mod

port.title: Port
port.description: Local port of the hub server (it listens on 127.0.0.1 only).

publicUrl.title: Address in your browser
publicUrl.description: Where your browser reaches the hub, when it differs from http://localhost:<port> (an SSH forward to another port, a tunnel). Empty: http://localhost:<port>.
